department: The Asian School of the Environment (ASE)

deadline.value: August 2027 intake deadline is January 31, 2027 (January intake deadline is July 31).
deadline.quote: For August and January admissions, the deadlines for applications are 31st January and 31st July, respectively.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for earth or environmental sciences.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: ASE strongly urges applicants to contact faculty members before applying to identify a supervisor and states applicants who do not contact faculty are unlikely to be admitted.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are strongly encouraged to visit the projects site of the ASE and contact faculty to discuss possible PhD topics. Applicants who do not contact faculty before applying are unlikely to be admitted to the program.

also.quote: Before applying, please contact individual ASE faculty members to discuss potential PhD opportunities and identify a suitable faculty supervisor.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are eligible on a competitive basis for the NTU Research Scholarship (S$3,000/month for international students, plus up to S$500/month after passing the Qualifying Examination, and annual tuition fee coverage for up to 4 years; S$3,400 PR / S$3,800 Singapore Citizen), as well as the Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship and Provost Graduate Award (S$4,300/month international).
funding.quote: Tuition fees will be in accordance with the fees set by the Ministry of Education and are subject to change. But, tuition fees should be covered under the scholarship schemes.

also.quote: The NTU Research Scholarship is awarded to outstanding graduate students for research. | In addition to the monthly stipend, the award also covers the annual tuition fee.

entry_route.value: Direct PhD entry from a bachelor's degree with minimum Honours (Distinction) or Second Class (Upper) Honours in a related science, engineering, or social science discipline.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor’s degree with minimum Honours (Distinction) or Second Class (Upper) Honours in a related science, engineering, or social science programme.

toefl_min.value: ASE requires TOEFL iBT 5.0+ (new 1-6 scale, Jan 2026+) or IELTS 6.5+ within 2 years unless waived via English-medium university instruction.
toefl_min.quote: A TOEFL (internet-based) score of 5.0 or more, or IELTS score of 6.5 or more, is required for international applicants for whom English is not their first language and/or graduates of universities in which English is not the medium of instruction.

ielts_min.value: ASE requires IELTS 6.5+ (or TOEFL iBT 5.0+ on the new scale) within 2 years unless waived via English-medium university instruction.
ielts_min.quote: A TOEFL (internet-based) score of 5.0 or more, or IELTS score of 6.5 or more, is required for international applicants for whom English is not their first language and/or graduates of universities in which English is not the medium of instruction.

english_waiver.value: TOEFL/IELTS is required only when English is not the applicant's first language and/or their university degree was not taught in English (university-level MOI letter accepted; NTU EPT may be arranged for selected applicants).
english_waiver.quote: A TOEFL (internet-based) score of 5.0 or more, or IELTS score of 6.5 or more, is required for international applicants for whom English is not their first language and/or graduates of universities in which English is not the medium of instruction.

also.quote: If the medium of instruction used in your studies is English, you may obtain a letter from your home University to certify the medium of instruction for waiver.

notes: Covers ASE's PhD in Earth and Environmental Science (geosciences, climate, geohazards, ecology, human-environment systems) and notes collaboration with Earth Observatory of Singapore (IGP-EOS).
